claim: Summer black truffle (Tuber aestivum, 'scorzone') is harvested June through August in the Langhe, making late May/early June the start of out-of-season truffle hunts when white-truffle prices and October-December crowds are absent.
quote: Summer Black Truffle (Tuber aestivum Vittadini), nicknamed scorzone for its hard, rough black-brown rind with large pyramidal warts, is harvested from June to August.

claim: Meet Piemonte runs private truffle-hunting walks in the Langhe/Roero/Monferrato woodlands paired with an agriturismo lunch, in the roughly EUR 200-300 per-person range.
quote: The Private Alba Truffle Hunting tour can take place in the woodlands of the Langhe, Roero, and Monferrato Hills in southern Piedmont.

claim: Tartufi Morra's historic Alba shop is at Piazza Pertinace 3, 12051 Alba (CN), reachable on +39 0173 364271, and offers in-shop tasting experiences year-round by appointment.
quote: Piazza Pertinace, 3, 12051 - Alba (CN), Italy. You can call them on +39 0173 364271 or send an email to info@tartufimorra.com.

claim: The Tartufi Morra shop was opened in 1930 by Giacomo Morra in the original Piazza Pertinace premises in Alba's historic centre.
quote: the original premises opened by Giacomo Morra in 1930

claim: The Banca del Vino in Pollenzo runs guided visits Monday-Saturday at fixed slots (09:45, 10:45, 11:45, 12:45 / 15:45, 16:45, 17:45) for EUR 2.50, with tastings from EUR 5 and an enoteca card system pouring glasses for EUR 2-6.
quote: guided visits are available daily at a price of EUR 2.50 with scheduled times at 9:45, 10:45, 11:45, and 12:45 in the morning, and at 15:45, 16:45, and 17:45 in the afternoon

claim: The UNISG campus in Pollenzo (a frazione of Bra, on the western edge of the 30 km radius from Serralunga) houses both the University and the Banca del Vino inside the Albergo dell'Agenzia complex founded by Carlo Petrini.
quote: The University of Gastronomic Sciences campus is in Pollenzo, a suburb of Bra, Italy... The complex includes the Banca del Vino (wine bank), and the Albergo dell'Agenzia.

claim: Slow Food's flagship 'Cheese' festival in Bra is biennial; the 15th edition ran 19-22 September 2025, so there is NO Cheese festival in 2026 - the next edition is September 2027.
quote: Cheese, the world's largest event dedicated to raw milk dairy products, returns to Bra, Italy from September 19 to 22, 2025.

claim: The next Cheese festival in Bra is scheduled for September 2027, with exact dates not yet announced.
The Istituto Internazionale di Elicicoltura in Cherasco runs full-day snail-farming 'Information Days' two-three times a month, usually on Saturdays, at Corso Einaudi 40.
quote: The Snail Breeding Institute of Cherasco organizes 2 to 3 times a month full-day training and information on snail farming, preferably on Saturdays.

claim: Cherasco is the recognised capital of Italian heliciculture; the Institute provides technical advice for breeders and stages an annual snail conference in September.
quote: The Istituto Internazionale di Elicicoltura in Cherasco provides technical advice for snail breeders (heliciculture is edible-snail breeding) and organises an annual snail festival

claim: Cherasco restaurants such as Osteria La Lumaca and Osteria della Rosa Rossa feature Cherasco snails on their menus, with the latter awarded for lumache fritte con cipolle.
Cuor di Nocciola in Cravanzana (Alta Langa) opens its 14-hectare Tonda Gentile hazelnut grove for self-guided trail walks with explanatory signage and a goat enclosure; booking via +39 392 4633764.
quote: The hazelnut grove extends over 14 hectares and can be explored by following a guided path through the trees... Phone: +39.392.4633764

claim: NoccioleNatura in Castino offers guided hazelnut-farm tours in Italian (EUR 20 per person) or English (EUR 25 per person), covering grove and processing through tasting.
quote: Guided tours are available in Italian (EUR 20 per person) or English (EUR 25 per person).

claim: The IGP-protected Tonda Gentile Trilobata variety reaches its peak expression in the Alta Langa, whose clay soils and Ligurian-current-mitigated climate also supply Ferrero's industrial hazelnut demand.
quote: the IGP Piedmont Hazelnut finds its maximum expression in the Alta Langa area, where the perfect balance between clay soil, climate mitigated by Ligurian currents and the right altitude make this portion of Piedmont optimal for growing the Tonda Gentile Trilobata variety

claim: The Alba White Truffle Fair (Fiera del Tartufo Bianco d'Alba) is firmly an autumn-only event running 10 October to 6 December 2026, so no white-truffle market is operating during a late-May/early-June stay.
quote: tickets cost EUR 5.25 for the fair taking place from 10th October to 6th December 2026
